coordinates_contract.inverse: Exact Fraction matrix composition/inverse and signed integer inequalities for target root-pixel bin; center candidates then at most65536 rows per denominator sign with bounded integer interval candidates. coordinates_contract.native_forward: Ordinary ordered double matrix operations, desktop-to-device range scale, normalized device transform, clip and device-to-desktop scale. Predicted truncated pixel must match original point exactly. Raw original root integers and processed native coordinates encoded FP32.32 via floor. These are predictions, not actual event receipts.
coordinates_contract.covered: Identity, translation, rotation/reflection, projective/negative denominator, true unbounded axes and bounded ranges, signed negative input, lattice-unreachable/signed-overflow rejection and candidate outside nearest rounding neighborhood. X/Y scroll conversion and zero normalization rejected.

aggregate_contract: WindowFocus.verify_pointer_configuration brackets actual leaf comparisons of target, XTEST pair, full button tables, XKB state/actions and full configuration with original native focus/session/released-state checks. No leaf result escapes before final guard; late focus drift rejects. Existing standalone verifiers kept. No cached leaf reads, cleared change latch, sequence reset or increased budgets. Complete fixture verifies one aggregate in<=256 requests and repeated motion checks within existing8192 lifetime; not claimed as global maximum for all topologies.
